releaseName: Lokify v1.3.9 – In-Card Admin Controls & In-App APK Updater
releaseNotes:
• Report Card Admin Controls: Municipal officers can now inspect all details and update status/SMS right from each report card's detail view.
• Removed standalone Admin Control Center.
• Direct In-App APK Updater: Updates download and launch installer directly in the app with zero browser redirect.
